title: Plant Disease Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks: A Review
summary: Surveys CNN-based approaches for classifying plant leaf diseases from images, covering common architectures and reported accuracy ranges on public leaf datasets.
gap: Most work assumes clean, well-lit images; robustness to noisy field conditions and small labeled datasets is under-explored.

title: Ensemble Methods for Crop Disease Classification with Limited Data
summary: Compares random forests, gradient boosting and SVMs for disease classification when only a small labeled dataset is available.
gap: Few studies report how quickly each method degrades as the number of disease classes grows.

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Introduces a framework where an agent verbally reflects on task feedback and stores the reflection as episodic memory to improve on the next attempt.
gap: Applies mainly to text-based decision tasks; applying the same reflect-and-retry loop to a full experiment pipeline (data, training, evaluation) is left open.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
summary: Proposes interleaving reasoning traces with actions so a language model can plan, act, and observe results within a single loop.
gap: Focuses on tool-use and QA benchmarks rather than iterative machine-learning experimentation with measurable metrics.

title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self Feedback
summary: Shows a model can improve its own output by generating feedback on a draft and revising accordingly, without additional training.
gap: Refinement is evaluated on generation tasks; refining a numeric experimental result against a hard target metric is not covered.
